messages:
liang_ml: FYI - onboarding galileo-v2 (quant=q5) on staging shows orthography regressions across locales. Repro + quick metrics below.

anya: what kind of regressions?

liang_ml: two clusters: (1) Hebrew niqqud (vowel points) shift left to previous consonant, (2) Mandarin pinyin tone numbers/marks glue to adjacent hanzi/latin (e.g., "ni3 hao3" -> "ni3hao3"). Also odd punctuation reflow in mixed RTL+CJK lines.

ryan_dev: example inputs/outputs?

liang_ml: run with `model=galileo-v2, quant=q5, tokenizer=unified-v2`
Input:
he: e9dcd5dd
zh: 4f60597d
mix: e9dcd5dd ni3 hao3

float16 baseline output:
he: [niqqud aligned correctly]
mix: ... ni3 hao3

q5 staging output:
he: [niqqud attached left]
mix: ...ni3hao3

liang_ml: quick eval (multilingual-sanchuan, beam=4):
float16: BLEU=24.7, chrF=46.2
q5 (pack+merge_subtokens): BLEU=23.1, chrF=42.9
delta: BLEU -1.6, chrF -3.3

marta_prod: is this tied to a tokenizer change or compile flags?

liang_ml: tokenizer version unified-v2 in both builds. q5 build enabled compile flag `merge_subtokens=true` and new packing (kernel reorder). Reverting merge_subtokens fixes short smoke.

ryan_dev: bisect compile flags + packer ordering. Also add failing prompts to canary blacklist. Run: `./run_eval.py --model galileo-v2 --quant q5 --compare fp16 --dataset multilingual-sanchuan --locales zh,he,ar --save-failures`.

liang_ml: ran CI job, artifacts: https://ci.internal/runs/4355004321 (fails.jsonl, metrics.json). eval-bot posted summary.

eval-bot: summary -> galileo-v2 fp16 BLEU=24.72 chrF=46.18; galileo-v2 q5 (pack+merge_subtokens) BLEU=23.09 chrF=42.87; saved 100 failing examples.

marta_prod: next steps: eng-ml bisect flags, eng-runtime inspect packer kernel ordering, add locale smoke tests (hebrew niqqud + zh pinyin tokenization) to release gating. Open tickets and temp revert merge_subtokens for q5 canary.

liang_ml: opened issue rwd/issues/2345 with fails.jsonl and a tiny repro `repro_q5_niqqud.py`. I'll attach token-id dumps for failing examples.

anya: also run q5-int8-compat path to see if packer is shared.

liang_ml: running that next, will update.

ryan_dev: thanks. Please include token ids around failing chars in the issue to help kernel folks.

liang_ml: will do. Checklist started: bisect flags (liang_ml), packer audit (eng-runtime), add smoke tests (marta_prod), revert merge_subtokens for q5 canary (liang_ml).

anya: nice triage. :thumbsup:
